summary: perf(shared-db): replace touchSessionToken Lua script with a transaction
description:
Because:

- The touchSessionToken Lua script packs tokens inside Redis, in Lua.

This commit:

- Replaces the script with a WATCH/GET/MULTI/SET/EXEC transaction, retried 3 times.
- Adds packSessionToken with the same merge rules and stored format.
- Runs touches one at a time on a lazy duplicate() connection.
- Counts conflicts in redis.touchSessionToken.conflict.
- Adds unit and integration specs, including a concurrency test.

Closes FXA-14927
